sheets.method: 七情 相惡 ①(藥性 약해짐)
sheets.setting: 七情 공용 체육관(맨벽 · 밝은 나무 바닥) · 둥근 파란 매트 셋, 짝 하나 = 매트 하나 · 교재 순서 왼→오, 짝의 앞 약이 왼쪽 · 相惡 = 마주 밀어붙인 무승부, 둘 다 주저앉고 둘의 노란 빛이 꺼져 회색 김(대칭 = 상호 견제)

stations.action: 혀 내민 연꽃이 몸통으로 生薑을 밀어붙임, 빛 꺼짐
물기 반짝 개구리가 맞밀다 주저앉음, 빛 꺼짐
부푼 점퍼가 소매로 乾薑을 밀어붙임(점퍼는 부푼 그대로), 빛 꺼짐
알통 자랑하던 마른 생강이 손바닥으로 맞밀다 주저앉음, 빛 꺼짐
왕관 인삼 인형이 손바닥으로 무를 밀어붙임(왕관 그대로), 빛 꺼짐
성난 흰 무(난폭자)가 씨를 퉤 뱉으며 맞밀다 주저앉음, 빛 꺼짐

sheets.boundaries: 相惡 = 藥性↓(노란 빛 꺼짐) ↔ 相畏 · 相殺 = 毒性↓(보라 구름 흩어짐) ↔ 相反 = 毒性↑(구름 터짐). 人蔘惡萊菔子(교재 괄호)는 매트3. 萊菔子는 S10 相反(地黃)에도 나옴 — 같은 무, 다른 관계. 生薑은 S8 相畏 · 防風은 S9 相殺에 다시 나옴(학습층 회수 문항). 교재 표기 人蔘 = 사전 人參.
sheets.prompt_en: Bright, cheerful cartoon illustration, wide 16:9 format, flat clean colors, bold outlines. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no labels and no writing anywhere in the picture. Setting: a bare gym hall seen from the front: a plain light wall with nothing on it (no shelves, no posters, no doors) and a light wooden floor. Three round blue floor mats lie in a row from left to right with clear empty gaps between them; each mat holds one pair of characters. On every mat the two partners face each other and push hard against each other in a stalemate — palm to palm if they have hands, body to body if they do not; both are exhausted and sagging at the knees, with sweat drops flying. Above each partner's head a soft warm yellow glow (a cloud-like aura, NOT a ring halo) is going out and fading into thin grey wisps of smoke. No purple cloud anywhere. Every character keeps exactly its own colors and shape as described; do not deflate, recolor or remove any part of any character. Mat 1 (left): [a yellow lotus flower with a cartoon face, scrunching its eyes and sticking its tongue out at a bitter taste, floating on a small lily pad] pushing against [a fresh, glistening, wet ginger root shaped like a frog crouching to jump, water droplets on its knobby skin]. Mat 2 (middle): [an empty zip-up windbreaker jacket puffed up like a balloon by a strong gust of wind, sleeves flapping], still fully puffed up, pushing with its sleeves against [a shriveled dried ginger root with bulging cartoon biceps flexing proudly while a doctor's stethoscope is pressed to its chest]. Mat 3 (right): [a small ginseng-root doll with forked root legs and tiny root arms, wearing a little golden crown and standing proudly], crown still on, pushing palm to palm against [An angry white daikon radish with a leafy green top and a furious cartoon face, stomping like a hooligan with clenched little fists and spitting small brown seeds out of its mouth; no text].

sheets.boundaries: S6과 같은 장치. 두문자 「백석」은 S9의 白芷+石雄黃(교재 표기)과 겹치므로 S9는 「백웅」으로 씀. 黃連은 相惡 두 짝(生薑 · 川芎).

sheets.method: 七情 相畏(毒性 약해짐 · 수동)
sheets.setting: 七情 공용 체육관(맨벽 · 밝은 나무 바닥) · 둥근 파란 매트 셋, 짝 하나 = 매트 하나 · 교재 순서 왼→오, 짝의 앞 약이 왼쪽 · 相畏 = 독 · 烈性 있는 앞 약(畏하는 쪽) 머리 위 보라 독구름, 뒤 약을 보고 움찔 움츠리자 제 구름이 흩어짐(포제 공용 표지). 뒤 약은 가만히 바라봄

물기 반짝 개구리가 가만히 바라봄(닿지 않음)
세신사가 독구름을 인 채 파우더 통을 보고 움찔, 구름 흩어짐

sheets.boundaries: 相畏(앞 약이 움츠림 · 제 구름) ↔ 相殺 S9(앞 약이 남의 구름을 흩음). 半夏畏生薑 = 生薑殺半夏(hp-03 「같은 사건 두 이름」) — 학습층. 人蔘畏五靈脂(교재 相畏 괄호 3492)는 그림에 넣지 않고 학습층에서 R2 G3 十九畏(함께 쓰지 않음 · 구름 없음)와 대조. 구름 = 교재 ※ 「毒性 약해짐」 칸 표지(麥門冬 · 細辛 등에 대해 독약이라 말하지 않음 — 교재 정의 毒性 · 烈性). 十九畏는 이 꼴을 쓰지 않음.
sheets.prompt_en: Bright, cheerful cartoon illustration, wide 16:9 format, flat clean colors, bold outlines. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no labels and no writing anywhere in the picture. Setting: a bare gym hall seen from the front: a plain light wall with nothing on it (no shelves, no posters, no doors) and a light wooden floor. Three round blue floor mats lie in a row from left to right with clear empty gaps between them; each mat holds one pair of characters. On every mat the LEFT character has a small purple poison cloud hovering over its own head; it looks at its RIGHT partner, flinches and cowers back in fear, and its own purple cloud is breaking apart into scattered wisps and fading away. The RIGHT partner just stands calmly and looks at it, not moving toward it and not touching it or the cloud. No yellow glow anywhere. Every character keeps exactly its own colors and shape as described; do not deflate, recolor or remove any part of any character. Mat 1 (left): [A grey hippo wearing bright shorts, both hind legs stuck in one leg of the shorts, toppling over with a surprised face] cowering under its fading purple cloud, facing [a fresh, glistening, wet ginger root shaped like a frog crouching to jump, water droplets on its knobby skin]. Mat 2 (middle): [a cheerful Korean bathhouse scrubber in shorts and a towel headband, waving one hand that wears a green exfoliating scrub mitt] cowering under its fading purple cloud, facing [A plain white baby-powder bottle with no label, with a big wide-open grinning cartoon face, puffing a soft cloud of fine white powder straight up out of its open top; no text] — the white powder rises straight up from the bottle only and never reaches the scrubber or the purple cloud. Mat 3 (right): [A frozen pollack fish, stiff and frosted with ice crystals, standing upright on its tail and clenching an unlabeled brown beer bottle in its mouth; no text] cowering under its fading purple cloud, facing [a ginseng-root doll dressed as a cramming high-school senior, wearing a plain blank white headband, tired eyes].

sheets.method: 七情 相殺(毒性 약해짐 · 능동)
sheets.setting: 七情 공용 체육관(맨벽 · 밝은 나무 바닥) · 둥근 파란 매트 셋, 짝 하나 = 매트 하나 · 교재 순서 왼→오, 짝의 앞 약이 왼쪽 · 相殺 = 독 있는 뒤 약 머리 위 보라 독구름을 앞 약(殺하는 쪽)이 불거나 휘저어 흩뜨림. 뒤 약은 멀뚱

stations.action: 부푼 점퍼가 소매를 펄럭여 돌풍을 일으켜 附子 머리 위 구름을 날려 흩음
불꽃 머리 도련님이 멀뚱, 머리 위 구름 흩어짐
이마에 백지 붙은 얼굴(백지 그대로)이 후 불어 웅덩이 위 구름을 흩음
노란 웅덩이에서 뱀이 튀어 도망, 웅덩이 위 구름 흩어짐
석유통 위 가죽 잎이 두 팔로 휘저어 댄서 머리 위 구름을 흩음
붉은 모래 댄서가 돌다 멈춰 멀뚱, 구름 흩어짐

sheets.boundaries: 相殺(앞 약이 남의 구름을 흩음) ↔ 相畏 S8(앞 약이 제 구름 · 움츠림). 生薑殺半夏 = 半夏畏生薑은 S8 학습층. 防風은 S6 相惡(乾薑)에도. 교재 표기 石雄黃 = 피규어 雄黃(확인 필요). 두문자는 교재 첫 음절이면 「백석」이나 S7과 겹쳐 「백웅」.
sheets.prompt_en: Bright, cheerful cartoon illustration, wide 16:9 format, flat clean colors, bold outlines. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no labels and no writing anywhere in the picture. Setting: a bare gym hall seen from the front: a plain light wall with nothing on it (no shelves, no posters, no doors) and a light wooden floor. Three round blue floor mats lie in a row from left to right with clear empty gaps between them; each mat holds one pair of characters. On every mat the RIGHT character has a small purple poison cloud hovering over its head and looks blank and unaware; the LEFT partner actively scatters that cloud — blowing it away or swatting it — so the purple cloud breaks apart into wisps and fades away. The left character has no cloud. No yellow glow anywhere. Every character keeps exactly its own colors and shape as described; do not deflate, recolor or remove any part of any character. Mat 1 (left): [an empty zip-up windbreaker jacket puffed up like a balloon by a strong gust of wind, sleeves flapping] flapping its sleeves to whip up a gust that blows away the purple cloud above [A smug rich young boy in a shiny tuxedo with a bow tie whose hair is a blazing fire, no top hat, no money, no gold ring, no text]. Mat 2 (middle): [a round cartoon face with one blank pure-white sheet of paper slapped flat onto its forehead, eyes looking up at it in surprise] — the paper stays stuck on its forehead — blowing a strong puff of breath that scatters the purple cloud hovering above [a bright yellow puddle with a startled green snake leaping out of it and fleeing]. Mat 3 (right): [A single thick, leathery dark-green leaf with a cartoon face and two small arms, standing proudly on top of a black oil drum whose lid glistens with spilled black oil; no label, no text] waving both arms to swat away the purple cloud above [A dancer whose whole body is made of bright red sand, caught mid-twirl with arms raised gracefully, red sand grains trickling from its fingertips and skirt; no text].

sheets.method: 七情 相反 ①(毒性 강해짐)
sheets.setting: 七情 공용 체육관(맨벽 · 밝은 나무 바닥) · 둥근 파란 매트 둘, 짝 하나 = 매트 하나 · 교재 순서 왼→오, 짝의 앞 약이 왼쪽 · 相反 = 짝이 하이파이브하는 순간 맞닿은 손에서 보라 독구름이 펑 부풀어 터짐, 둘 다 튕겨 남

stations.action: 땅을 뚫고 솟은 노란 옷 황제가 손을 뻗어 하이파이브 → 펑, 뒤로 튕김
성난 흰 무가 하이파이브 → 펑(S6에선 人參과 相惡)

sheets.boundaries: 相反 ↔ 相惡: 萊菔子가 S6(人參 · 빛 꺼짐)과 S10(地黃 · 구름 터짐)에 다 나옴. 교재 地黃 = 새 피규어(熟地黃 = 검은 옷 · 숙제와 가름). 甘草+大戟/甘遂는 피규어 여섯 한도로 S11.
sheets.prompt_en: Bright, cheerful cartoon illustration, wide 16:9 format, flat clean colors, bold outlines. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no labels and no writing anywhere in the picture. Setting: a bare gym hall seen from the front: a plain light wall with nothing on it (no shelves, no posters, no doors) and a light wooden floor. Two round blue floor mats lie in a row from left to right with clear empty gaps between them; each mat holds one pair of characters. On every mat the two partners give each other a high-five; at the very moment their hands (or leaves) meet, a big purple poison cloud bursts out of the touching point with jagged burst lines, puffing up larger than both of them, and both are knocked backward in shock. No skull in the cloud. No yellow glow anywhere. Every character keeps exactly its own colors and shape as described; do not deflate, recolor or remove any part of any character. Mat 1 (left): [An emperor in an earth-stained bright yellow robe and a yellow crown (his skin an ordinary cartoon tone, young face, no beard), bursting up out of a hole in the ground to his waist with clumps of soil flying, both hands empty; no notebook, no text] — rising out of a hole in the floor at the edge of the mat — high-fives [An angry white daikon radish with a leafy green top and a furious cartoon face, stomping like a hooligan with clenched little fists and spitting small brown seeds out of its mouth; no text]. Mat 2 (right): [A yellow lotus flower with a cartoon face, cheeks puffed, blowing hard on a silver whistle held in its mouth (no tongue showing), floating on a small lily pad; no text] high-fives with one leaf [A small root-doll figure with a ginseng-root body and tiny root arms and legs, made of black porous basalt rock full of little holes, no text].

sheets.method: 七情 相反 ②(毒性 강해짐) = 十八反 甘草 무리 다리
sheets.setting: 七情 공용 체육관 · 큰 둥근 파란 매트 하나 · 왼쪽 甘草 약장, 오른쪽 大戟 무대 위에 甘遂 감옥 · 같은 相反 문법(맞닿는 점 하나에서 펑)

stations.action: 서랍에서 얼굴 내민 감초 뿌리 하나가 팔처럼 길게 뻗어 甘遂와 하이파이브 → 펑
붉은 막 걷힌 빈 대극장 무대 — 甘遂 감옥이 그 위에 놓임, 막이 독구름에 휩싸임
줄무늬 죄수가 쇠창살 사이로 한 손을 내밀어 하이파이브 → 펑

sheets.boundaries: 七情 相反 甘草+大戟/甘遂 = 十八反 甘草 反 大戟 · 芫花 · 甘遂 · 海藻(R1 F2)의 일부 — 학습층 다리. R1 F2가 같은 相反 터짐을 쓰면 이 장을 F2에 접을 수 있음(메인 결정). 芫花 · 海藻는 七情 相反 예가 아니므로 이 장에 세우지 않음.
sheets.prompt_en: Bright, cheerful cartoon illustration, wide 16:9 format, flat clean colors, bold outlines. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no labels and no writing anywhere in the picture. Setting: a bare gym hall seen from the front: a plain light wall with nothing on it (no shelves, no posters, no doors) and a light wooden floor. One large round blue floor mat in the middle. Exactly three characters. The left one gives a high-five to the right one; at the very moment they touch, a big purple poison cloud bursts out of the touching point with jagged burst lines and billows over the stage, and both are knocked back in shock. No skull in the cloud. No yellow glow. Every character keeps exactly its own colors and shape as described; do not deflate, recolor or remove any part of any character. Left: [A small wooden Korean herbal medicine cabinet with many little drawers, and from every open drawer the same cheerful yellow licorice root pokes out its smiling face; no labels or writing anywhere]; one of the smiling licorice roots stretches far out of its drawer like a long arm. Right: [A grand theater stage front with gold columns and heavy red velvet curtains drawn open on an empty stage, no sign, no letters], and standing on that stage is [A prisoner in a black-and-white striped uniform gripping the iron bars of a small jail cell door with both hands, no fruit, no text], who pushes one hand out between the bars to meet the licorice root in a high-five.
